title: CIP Safety: Fix CRC logic when timestamp rolls over to zero
description:
1. Use rollover_value=0, until we have seen the Time Coordination message (This is the main fix)
2. Extract Method: get_timestamp_packet_data
3. Remove duplicate/unnecessary call to calculate the timestamp data

Closes https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/issues/14939
